jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Banking Functional Analyst
jobs.description:
Like Morgane, Functional Analyst at Cream, you act as a bridge between business and IT teams within the banking sector. You translate business needs into functional specifications for digital platforms such as mobile applications, AI solutions or e-Commerce tools. Your projects may relate to payments, credit or compliance for example.
Your tasks will be

• Understand and translate business requirements into detailed functional specifications

• Act as the link between business stakeholders and IT teams

• Follow up with technical analysts, designers and developers

• Describe test scenarios, prepare test data and coordinate test execution with the Test Coordinator

• Analyse results and propose corrective actions where needed

• Ensure consistency and quality of deliverables throughout the project lifecycle

• Dive into technical aspects when necessary

• Work closely with business teams to ensure the delivered solution meets their expectations

What do we expect from our Consultant ?

• You have proven experience in Functional Analysis in the banking sector

• Very good knowledge of analysis tools and methodologies (UML, RUP, ARIS, Visio, Enterprise Architect, Jira, ...)

• You can meet project deadlines and provide high quality deliverables

• You have strong communication skills and analytical skills

• You are fluent in French and English, a good knowledge of Dutch is also required

-

We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

The Cream recipe

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues :)
Your future projects 

As Marc, .NET Developer, come and work on the latest .NET technologies. You will have the opportunity to work on various types of projects : Internet and mobile applications, Business administration tools (pricing, contracts management, billing...), Electronic document management solutions (medical prescription, notarial deeds...) or Intelligent apps. Your tasks will be

• Communicate with business analysts for understanding the UML specifications and designs that form the basis for implementation

• Communicate with technical architect to understand the constraints of the architecture that must be respected

• Do bottom-up research for problem diagnostics

• Implement business & technical components

• Design and develop custom software solutions

• Document code in a clear and concise manner

• Test the new application (unit tests, integration tests)

• Work independently following the priorities and timing of the release and Sprint planning

What do we expect from our Consultant ?

• 
Extensive experience in .NET development

• 
Experience with frameworks/tools like Xamarin, LINQ, NetBeans, Entity, Visual Studio, Eclypse, Silverlight, VFP, MVC

• Love to think about the business benefits of your developments

• Enjoy to write performing code and have a natural orientation toward quality

• Love to propose improvements to the rest of the team

• Love to challenge your ideas

• Master French or Dutch & English

-

Embrace your role and work on various projects: Internet and mobile application, Digital/e-Commerce, Artificial Intelligence, real-time,...
Your tasks 

• Translating the business requirements into detailed functional designs

• Follow-up of technical analysts and developers

• Describing the test scenarios, prepare test data and organize the test execution working in close relationship with the Test coordinator

• Analysing potential corrective actions to be taken

• Following up of technical designers and programmers

• Being able to go into technical details

• Working closely with the business to ensure the final solution fits their needs

• Very good knowledge of analysis tools and methodologies (UML, RUP, ARIS, Visio, Enterprise Architect, Jira, ...)

Our client is a logistics service provider based in Antwerp.

Jobomschrijving

Are you an experienced Technical Superintendent or maritime engineer with a passion for inland shipping, vessel management, and technical operations? Do you speak German fluently and enjoy working closely with crews and shipyards?

This is your opportunity to take a key role in managing a modern inland fleet in the Antwerp region.

Your Role as Technical Superintendent

As a Technical Superintendent Inland Shipping, you are responsible for the technical performance, maintenance, and reliability of the fleet. You act as the crucial link between crew, suppliers, and management.

Key responsibilities:
	
• Monitor the technical condition and operational performance of vessels	
• Plan and coordinate maintenance, repairs, and inspections	
• Visit vessels regularly (2–3 times per week)	
• Provide technical support to crews and build strong working relationships	
• Handle technical incidents and breakdowns (on-call rotation)	
• Manage and execute technical projects, refits, and upgrades	
• Develop and follow up on preventive maintenance plans (PMS)	
• Maintain contact with shipyards, suppliers, and classification societies	
• Manage the technical budget and advise on long-term investments

Your Profile:
	
• Bachelor’s degree in Maritime Technology, Electromechanics, or Engineering	
• Proven experience as a Technical Superintendent / Vessel Manager (preferably inland shipping)	
• Fluent in German and English (mandatory requirement)	
• Knowledge of ship engines, propulsion systems, and electrical installations	
• Experience with PMS systems and technical documentation	
• Familiar with classification rules and maritime regulations	
• Strong problem-solving skills and a hands-on mentality	
• Excellent communicator, able to connect with technical teams and crew	
• Flexible and willing to travel frequently

Our customer is an international company active in the healthcare industry (medical devices) having its European headquarters based in Zaventem.

Jobomschrijving

As Payroll & Benefits Specialist, you are responsible for the full, accurate and timely management of the company's payroll administration for all employees, in full compliance with legal requirements and internal policies.
You play a central role in optimising payroll processes, with a strong affinity for Compensation & Benefits, and actively contribute to broader HR projects.

- Deliver ad-hoc reporting and analytics, providing detailed insights into payroll costs, HR trends and other key performance indicators.

- Manage and continuously improve processes related to leave, absences and employee benefits (insurance plans, meal vouchers, etc.).
- Act as the primary point of contact for employees regarding payroll and benefits-related queries, with the ability to clearly explain payroll related processes.
- Actively contribute to HR projects, including initiatives aimed at improving payroll and compensation efficiency and the implementation of new HR tools or solutions.
- Ensure full compliance with social and tax legislation and promote best practices within the payroll function.

The ideal candidate can demonstrate the following skills and experience:

- You hold a Bachelor or Master degree in a relevant field or equivalent by experience

- You can demonstrate more than 4 years of experience in payroll management. Any additional experience with the UK, Germany, or the Netherlands payroll systems is considered an asset.

- You have a very good knowledge of the Belgian social legislation

- You are fluent in English both written and spoken, any other language is an asset

- You possess good communication skills allowing you to clearly explain HR payroll related processes to varied stakeholders

Project description

In this role, you lead complex multidisciplinary industrial engineering projects within the process industry. You are fully accountable for scope, budget, planning, quality and safety across both new installations and major modifications to existing assets.

Primary Tasks & Responsibilities

• Take end-to-end ownership of industrial engineering projects from concept and feasibility through commissioning and final handover.
• Define and manage project scope, deliverables, budget (including business case and investment approval) and baseline planning in MS Project.
• Coordinate all project phases: pre-study and concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement and contractor selection, construction and site execution, commissioning, and handover to operations.
• Act as the single point of accountability for internal stakeholders and management.
• Lead multidisciplinary teams across mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS disciplines, working with both internal and external parties.
• Manage scope changes, risks, claims, and deviations affecting budget or schedule.
• Report progress, issues and decisions to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

• Minimum 10 years of experience as a Project Manager with proven A-Z ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.

• Mandatory experience in the process industry.
• Strong hands-on command of MS Project, with ownership of planning rather than follow-up only.
• Academic working level combined with strong analytical skills and a helicopter view.
